name: Taj Mahal
hindi_description: Agra me Yamuna nadi ke tat par sthit safed sangmarmar ka vishwa prasiddh aashcharya.

name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
hindi_description: Purani Dilli me lal balua patthar se bana qila jahan se Swatantrata Diwas par Tiranga phahraya jata hai.

name: India Gate
hindi_description: Kartavya Path par sthit 42 meter uncha shaheed sainikon ka smarak jahan Amar Jawan Jyoti jalti hai.

name: Statue of Unity
hindi_description: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ji ki 182 meter unchi pratima jo poori duniya ki sabse unchi murti hai.

name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib)
hindi_description: Sone se sajha pavitra sarovar ke beech sthit gurudwara jahan 24 ghante prasad aur langar chalta hai.

name: Gateway of India
hindi_description: Mumbai ke Colaba me Arab Sagar ke tat par sthit bhavya arch smarak.

name: Hawa Mahal
hindi_description: Gulabi nagri Jaipur me 953 jharokhon wala lal-gulabi mahal jahan thandi hawa aati hai.

name: Qutub Minar
hindi_description: Bharat ki sabse unchi eent se bani minar (72.5 meter) jo Mehrauli me sthit hai.

name: Konark Sun Temple
hindi_description: Pathhar par tarasha hua Sooraj Bhagwan ka vishalkay rath jisme 24 pahiye aur 7 ghode hain.

name: Charminar
hindi_description: Char bhavya minaron wali aitihasik imarat jo Hyderabad ki pehchan hai.

name: Mysore Palace
hindi_description: Dussehra me 1 lakh roshniyon se jagmagata Karnataka ka shandar rajmahal.

name: Victoria Memorial
hindi_description: Safed sangmarmar se bana Kolkata ka prashidhdha sngrahalaya aur sundar bageecha.

name: Kailash Temple, Ellora Caves
hindi_description: Ek hi vishal pathhar ko upar se neeche tarash kar banaya gaya anokha Kailash mandir.

name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
hindi_description: Samrat Ashoka dwara banwaya gaya prachin Bauddh stupa aur toran dwar.

name: Dal Lake & Shikara
hindi_description: Kashmir ki sundar jheel jahan tairte hue houseboat aur Shikara naav chalte hain.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
hindi_description: Rang-birangi hazaron dev pratimaon se saje gopuram wala aitihasik mandir.

name: Eiffel Tower
hindi_description: Paris me sthit 330 meter uncha lohe ka tower jo duniya bhar ke paryatakon ko aakarshit karta hai.

name: Great Pyramids of Giza
hindi_description: Registan me hazaron saal purane vishal pathhar ke pyramid jo prachin kaal ke 7 aashcharyon me se hain.

name: The Colosseum
hindi_description: Rome ka vishal prachin amphitheatre jahan gladiator matches hote the.

name: Great Wall of China
hindi_description: Hazaron kilometer lambi pathhar aur eent ki deewar jo pahadon par saamp ki tarah phaili hui hai.

name: Machu Picchu
hindi_description: Andes parvatmala ke unche shikhar par baadal ke beech basa prachin Inca nagar.

name: Lotus Temple
hindi_description: Kamal ke phool ke aakaar ka safed sangmarmar mandir jahan sabhi dharmo ke log shanti se dhyan lagate hain.

name: Swaminarayan Akshardham
hindi_description: Bhavya lal balua patthar aur sangmarmar par nikaashi se bana sanskritik mandir parisar.

name: White Desert (Rann of Kutch)
hindi_description: Poornima ki raat ko chandi jaisa chamakta safed namak ka vishal registan.

name: Jaisalmer Golden Fort (Sonar Qila)
hindi_description: Thar registan me peele balua patthar se bana qila jo dhoop me sone ki tarah chamakta hai.

name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
hindi_description: Bharat ke dakshin chhor par teen samundaron ke sangam par sthit Swami Vivekananda ji ka dhyan smarak.
